purpose: Openly licensed instrument onset regression fixtures

files.onset_annotation_type: normalized-envelope estimate; not a physical keypress/pluck annotation

onset_estimator.envelope: RMS centered at each window midpoint
onset_estimator.normalization: divide RMS by source maximum RMS
onset_estimator.uncertainty_note: Threshold-dependent acoustic envelope marker with 1ms grid and 5ms RMS window; guitar source starts during its initial attack, so complete original attack may be truncated.

files.permission_summary: University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples may be downloaded and used for any projects without restrictions, according to the collection owner.
files.attribution: Lawrence Fritts, University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios; performed by Evan Mazunik
files.processing: FFmpeg stereo downmix where needed; resample to 48000 Hz; crop to 150 ms pre-roll and 2.75 s post-onset; digital silence pad only where source pre-roll unavailable; PCM16 conversion; no gain normalization.
